author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The secret of the power of unlimited tokens is you can just let the AI keep guessing, after a while it will get the correct answer by pure luck.

It is not quite as bad as the infinite monkey theorem, I named it the infinite intern theorm.

Buy more GPUs, burn more tokens, miracles will happen.
